proposal.name: Use real Go evidence in repository checks

plan.name: Use real Go evidence in repository checks
plan.summary: Connect the existing Go selection, discovery, producer and local collector to the explicitly configured repository base and candidate paths and their shared check queue, using the existing optional process transport without another runner, scheduler, selector policy or parser. Require authentic starts and terminals only on this real Go path: each base selector needs its own completed test failure, independent selectors continue after ordinary build, suite, test and selected-package compilation failures while allowance remains, candidates require every applicable command and selector to pass, and Go compiler errors remain setup refusals rather than qualifying failures. Keep completed evidence and full identities through infrastructure vetoes, clipped diagnostics and queue transport; preserve captured authority, the inherited twelve-minute run capped by caller, sandbox and preparer, one ten-minute phase starting at the first suite test or discovery including test_one -timeout=0, and serial environment-before-staging cleanup under fifteen uncanceled seconds with the queue slot held until cleanup ends. Add separate default integration fixtures with real local Go and no Docker or network while preserving all existing acceptance_*, go_*, native_* and other tests and fakes unchanged, including evidence515 terminals without running records, with default adapters, configured planning admission and external plumbing still disabled and legacy Go unchanged. Update SPEC.md with decision citations, docs/factory.md with the implemented lifecycle and its limits, and the README within 400 lines without claiming Docker evidence; the merger records the integration refinement of D-0316, D-0321 and D-0327 on D-0107, D-0108, D-0110, D-0111, D-0121, D-0173, D-0281, D-0282, D-0301, D-0305, D-0311 and D-0314, handles unavailable Docker or network checks, and leaves affected real Python and TLAPS suites required in CI.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGoRealOutcomes582
tests.says: Real base assertions become candidate passes after production-only changes with identical pinned bytes; passes, assertions, panics, skips, missing execution and abrupt exits retain their exact outcomes on both paths.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGoIndependentEvidence582
tests.says: Base checks try independent selectors after build, suite and selected-package compilation failures without broadcasting outcomes across cases, packages, modules or parts; candidates require all commands and selectors.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGoEvidenceIntegrity582
tests.says: Real controls and damaged private streams distinguish authentic completion from forged diagnostics, missing terminals and transport failure; completed evidence and reasons survive vetoes, clipped output and JSON.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGoSharedLifetime582
tests.says: Real Go commands, discovery and execution share the original run and one phase started by suite or discovery, obey shorter caller, sandbox and preparer limits, and keep partial work and bounded cleanup when canceled at each stage.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGoQueueAndCleanup582
tests.says: Queued real Go checks retain host authority and structured evidence, cancel waiting calls without execution, and keep their slot until environment and staging cleanup finish, with cleanup errors vetoing completed runs.

usage.summary: Wrote [plan.json](plan.json) and five acceptance tests for the complete step, leaving `repo/` unchanged. Check 1 passed: all five tests fail on the base as required; the eventual PR requires a person to merge it.
